resources.string: The name appears in the alert and history. A short, clear phrase works best.
Add optional details that will appear with the reminder name.
Active controls scheduling. Critical alerts immediately even while you are asleep or the watch is off your wrist.
Repeats every week on the selected weekdays at the same time. Useful for weekday medication or a regular weekly task.
Appears only once at the selected date and time, and does not repeat afterward.
Repeats at a chosen interval, such as every number of hours, days, weeks, months, or years, starting from a selected date.
Repeats once a year on a Gregorian or Hebrew date. It can alert several hours early and include a number that increases each year.
Tie the reminder to a daily halachic time calculated for your location, with an optional offset before or after it.
The date is the starting point. For yearly or monthly Hebrew-date repeats, the app converts each occurrence to the matching Gregorian date.
The reminder end time must be later than the start time.
If a starting number is entered, it will appear in parentheses and increase by 1 each year.
The changes from the phone are invalid
The phone sent only the changes made there. This will update or delete only what changed and will not overwrite snoozes, history, or other runtime state.
The phone sent a backup to the watch. Restore it now? All existing reminders will be replaced.
Zmanio needs notifications to show the reminders you create at the right time. On the next screen, the watch will ask you to allow notifications.
Your location is used to calculate accurate daily and halachic times for your area. Zmanio does not share it. On the next screen, the watch will request location access.

Zmanio uses this permission to detect when you are asleep. It can then avoid alerting during sleep, wait, and show the reminder after you wake up. It is not used for step counting or workout tracking. On the next screen, the watch will request activity-recognition access.

To avoid waking you during sleep or alerting while the watch is off your wrist, Zmanio uses sensors to detect the current state. It can then alert you at the right time, or wait until you are awake and wearing the watch again. On the next screen, the watch will request sensor access.
This allows an important reminder to appear over the current screen even while the watch is locked. On the next screen, enable it for Zmanio.

To make reminders ring on time even when the watch is saving power or the screen is off, allow Alarms & reminders for this app. On the screen that opens, find Zmanio or Alarms & reminders, open Zmanio, and turn on Allow.
On the screen that opens, enable Alarms & reminders so reminders can run on time.
